description: Fork of exp667 (S=1 qk, tph=64; tracking exp666 within 2-3 mb). Single change: qk_tph 64 -> 128 (2x). qk_lut params: 6*128*16*128 = 1,572,864 per layer (+0.79M); total qk +4.72M. Expected total ~97.5M (was 92.8M). Tests whether MORE qk capacity helps once split-S is removed (S=1, no input-diversity bonus). Per-token qk_lut bandwidth doubles (192 KB -> 384 KB/layer); total LUT bandwidth 4.5 MB -> 4.7 MB/token, still 4.5x under vanilla. Reference: exp666 = 1.4544 (92.8M, current SOTA), exp667 = ~ exp666 + 0.0025 at step 6200. exp668 needs to beat exp666 = 1.4544 to validate the bigger-qk hypothesis at S=1.
